origin.description: Replace code points from a character class.
origin.usage: stri_replace_all_charclass(str, pattern, replacement, merge = FALSE, vectorize_all = TRUE, vectorise_all = vectorize_all)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Text that replaces each match. NA makes the whole string NA when a match exists.

arguments.name: merge
arguments.text: If TRUE, one replacement covers a whole run of matches.

arguments.name: vectorize_all
arguments.text: If TRUE, recycle str, pattern, and replacement together. If FALSE, apply each pattern to every string.

origin.details: With vectorize_all FALSE, pattern must be at least as long as replacement. A missing pattern makes every result NA. A miss keeps the original string, including when the replacement is NA.
origin.example:
x <- stri_replace_all_charclass("a b", "\\p{Z}", "_")
sentence <- paste0('stri_replace_all_charclass("a b", "\\p{Z}", "_") returns ', x, '.')
writeLines(sentence)

translation.description: Replace code points from a character class.
translation.usage: stri_replace_all_charclass(str, pattern, replacement, merge=False, vectorize_all=True, vectorise_all=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: An ICU UnicodeSet pattern: \p{L}, \p{N}, \p{WhiteSpace}, [:WhiteSpace:], or [a-z]. A bare name such as WhiteSpace, and \w, are not patterns. An empty pattern is an error. Membership is ICU 76, Unicode 16.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Text that replaces each match. NA makes the whole string NA when a match exists.

arguments.name: merge
arguments.text: If true, one replacement covers a whole run of matches.

arguments.name: vectorize_all
arguments.text: If true, recycle str, pattern, and replacement together. If false, apply each pattern to every string.

translation.details: With vectorize_all false, pattern must be at least as long as replacement. A missing pattern makes every result NA. A miss keeps the original string, including when the replacement is NA.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing result is NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.charclass import stri_replace_all_charclass
x = stri_replace_all_charclass("a b", "\\p{Z}", "_")
sentence = f'stri_replace_all_charclass("a b", "\\p{{Z}}", "_") returns {x[0]}.'
print(sentence)
